title: Paygent — virtual cards for AI agents to pay autonomously (capability signal)
gap: Payment was the last blocked step between 'agent that recommends' and 'agent that finishes the errand'.

zh.gap: 支付是「会推荐的 agent」和「能把事办完的 agent」之间最后一段断路。
zh.pain: 每个「替我办完」的消费级 agent 都卡死在同一步：到了付款，它没有手。
zh.kill: 信任与责任未解——agent 刷错一笔就烧光一年的信任；而支付轨道握在发卡方和平台手里，他们随时可以原生做掉。
zh.move: 不是拿来做——信号在于：帮你退订遗忘的订阅、改签更便宜的票、缴周期账单这类「办完型」消费 agent，端到端在技术上刚被打通。

pain: Every 'do it for me' consumer agent hits the same missing limb at checkout: it cannot pay.
kill: Trust and liability are unresolved — one wrong charge by an agent erases a year of goodwill; and the rails belong to issuers and platform owners who can ship this natively.
move: Not to build — the signal: consumer agents that cancel forgotten subscriptions, re-book the cheaper fare, or pay the recurring bill just became technically closeable end-to-end.
